description: This Java class defines an HttpServlet called UpdateProduct that handles POST requests for updating product details in an online grocery ordering system. It retrieves form data, calls a database utility to update the product, and redirects or forwards based on success.

classes.name: UpdateProduct
classes.description: A servlet for processing product update requests in the online grocery system.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update product details, invoking database update and redirecting or forwarding based on success.
